title: swap-and-pop whitelist remove reorders _nudgeTokens; positional minRewards[i] can bind to the wrong token across an owner remove+add race
description: Owner removes a whitelisted token via setNudgeTokenWhitelist(token,false); removal is swap-and-pop (the LAST token moves into the removed slot), so getNudgeTokens() ordering changes. A caller who fetched the token order before the reorder submits batchMint with a positional minRewards[] now mapped to the wrong tokens. The per-token floor check compares each stale minRewards[i] against a different token's snapshot.
impact: None to protocol funds. minRewards[] is a FLOOR check only -- the whole prior pot is paid regardless of the floor -- so no over- or under-payment of assets results. Worst case for a caller is an unexpected revert (their token's floor applied to a different token after a swap-and-pop reorder = self-DoS) or a floor guarantee bound to a different token than intended (positional/UI mismatch). CODE-VER-07 confirms index integrity + length checks (no OOB, no wrong-token payout). Law-3 non-obvious owner/caller ordering footgun.
attackPath: 1. Owner removes a whitelisted token via setNudgeTokenWhitelist(token,false); removal is swap-and-pop (the LAST token moves into the removed slot), so getNudgeTokens() ordering changes.
2. A caller who fetched the token order before the reorder submits batchMint with a positional minRewards[] now mapped to the wrong tokens.

3. The per-token floor check compares each stale minRewards[i] against a different token's snapshot -- a spurious revert (self-DoS) or a floor silently protecting the wrong token. CODE-VER-07 confirms index integrity + length checks (no OOB, no wrong-token payout).
recommendation: Callers/UI must re-fetch getNudgeTokens() immediately before every batchMint (already in NatSpec). Consider a token-keyed minRewards mapping or an expected-ordering hash argument so positional drift fails closed against the intended token rather than a silently-rebound one.
distinction: Kept distinct from ledger L-05 990d8c37 (wont-fix, minRewards zero-default opt-out) and Q-01 cabd4a3d (open) per dedup -- different root cause, do not collapse.
relabelNote: Relabeled L-02->L-01 (run-22): 43e8c486 escalated out of the Low band to Medium M-01. Run-22 Low label L-02 is a deliberate gap.
